item.title: For Helen, a software engineer at our Meadowpoint Campus in San Jose, transitioning into a new role is all about the mindset. “Be a sponge,” she adv...
item.description:
For Helen, a software engineer at our Meadowpoint Campus in San Jose, transitioning into a new role is all about the mindset. “Be a sponge,” she advises. “Learn from the people around you, take initiative in your own learning, be highly receptive to feedback and never hesitate to ask for help."
Now nine months into her role on the Identity and Engagement team, Helen is helping phase out traditional text verification in favor of seamless, carrier-integrated authentication. She keeps her day-to-day dynamic by tackling two distinct tracks: “One line of my work involves leveraging machine learning to optimize and save costs across our verification lifecycle. Separately, I work on a project transforming the user experience for phone number verification in third-party apps: one tap and you're verified; no need to type digits!”
While the tech is complex, Helen has found that the most crucial skills for success are actually soft skills. “People say it time and time again, but collaboration and teamwork,” she emphasizes. “It’s that constant interaction that actually makes the work happen.”
Explore our open software engineering opportunities → https://goo.gle/4vkzjZe

item.title: With 4.6 billion people worldwide lacking access to essential health services, we're taking the next step to help close the gap. In 2023, Google Resea...
item.description:
With 4.6 billion people worldwide lacking access to essential health services, we're taking the next step to help close the gap. In 2023, Google Research collaborated with the World Health Organization to launch Open Health Stack, a suite of open-source tools to help developers build next-gen digital health solutions. Today we're transferring Open Health Stack to the Linux Foundation to accelerate global digital health innovation and are announcing the Open Health Stack Software Foundation.
The Open Health Stack Software Foundation will provide a vendor-neutral, community-governed future for the essential building blocks for global digital health. The foundation is also introducing a program that will allow local startups, small businesses and developers to participate directly in its governance without financial barriers. Plus, Google.org is providing a $3 million grant to support the long-term growth of the project.
Learn more about the OHS-SF. https://goo.gle/4frE1ij

item.title: Meet Wei, a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Singapore. Wei built his career in AI by teaching himself machine learning with open-source tool...
item.description:
Meet Wei, a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Singapore. Wei built his career in AI by teaching himself machine learning with open-source tools. Today, he uses that proactive curiosity to bring advanced cloud technology directly to global businesses — like a recent project co-building safety guardrails for a bank’s generative AI financial products.
By collaborating with internal Product and Engineering teams, Wei turns customer feedback into upgraded product features. He credits his supportive Singapore office community with keeping his well-being balanced and confidence high. "I might not know everything, but knowing there is always someone around who can help gives me the confidence to tackle new technical challenges,” he says. And to stay ahead in a fast-moving field, he shares that continuous learning is non-negotiable.
Want to build cutting-edge AI tools with a team that always has your back? Join our collaborative community in Singapore and explore open Forward Deployed Engineering positions today → https://goo.gle/3PUwMWc

item.title: It can be easy to lose valuable time in your workday to digital busywork like sorting files, migrating notes and jumping between tabs. ✨ Gemini Spark...
item.description:
It can be easy to lose valuable time in your workday to digital busywork like sorting files, migrating notes and jumping between tabs. ✨ Gemini Spark ✨ is your 24/7 personal AI agent in the Gemini app, designed to take proactive action on your behalf so you can focus on high-value execution.
Give Gemini Spark a task and it works securely in the background to complete multi-step workflows, even if your phone and laptop are turned off.
Here's what's rolling out today to help you cross off your most complex to-dos:
🍎 Automate manual desktop chores: Gemini Spark is now available in the Gemini app for macOS, letting you run tasks like instantly sorting all the PDFs in your Downloads folder, or using the latest invoices saved to your computer to build a budget spreadsheet that updates on a regular schedule.
✅ Turn raw notes into clear tasks: Gemini Spark connects directly with Google Keep and Google Tasks to streamline your daily checklist. This lets you do things like automatically scan your scattered brain-dumps inside Keep and translate them into structured action items.
🔌 Tailor your assistant: Support for custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives you the ability to connect your favorite apps directly into Gemini Spark to build a more tailored assistant.
📎 Connect Gemini Spark to your favorite apps: Design custom flyers with Canva, access and share your files with Dropbox, make reservations on OpenTable, order your weekly groceries with Instacart, reserve an apartment tour with Zillow Rentals, and more without you ever having to jump between browser windows.
🗞️ Real-time updates without constantly hitting refresh: Smart schedules allow you to set conditional triggers that run automatically the moment specific parameters are met. You can tell Spark to execute tasks based on live events, like emailing you a match summary the moment a soccer game ends, or automatically serving you a detailed financial report if a stock reaches a specific threshold.
Gemini Spark is available in Beta for Google AI Ultra subscribers aged 18+ in the U.S. and this suite of new features is starting to roll out today.
Learn more → goo.gle/4eHGHby
